question: open restaurants per building top 10
sql: WITH joined AS (SELECT b.id AS building_id, b.names.primary AS building_name, p.id AS place_id FROM lisbon_buildings b JOIN lisbon_places p ON ST_Intersects(b.geometry, p.geometry) WHERE p.basic_category = 'restaurant' AND p.operating_status = 'open') SELECT building_id, building_name, COUNT(DISTINCT place_id) AS restaurant_count FROM joined GROUP BY building_id, building_name ORDER BY restaurant_count DESC, building_id LIMIT 10;

question: bakeries by building subtype
sql: SELECT b.subtype, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS bakery_count FROM lisbon_buildings b JOIN lisbon_places p ON ST_Intersects(b.geometry, p.geometry) WHERE p.taxonomy.primary = 'bakery' GROUP BY b.subtype ORDER BY bakery_count DESC, b.subtype;

question: clothing stores in commercial buildings by class
sql: SELECT b.class AS building_class, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS store_count FROM lisbon_buildings b JOIN lisbon_places p ON ST_Intersects(b.geometry, p.geometry) WHERE p.basic_category = 'fashion_and_apparel_store' AND b.subtype = 'commercial' GROUP BY b.class ORDER BY store_count DESC, building_class;

question: personal beauty services per residential building top 10
sql: SELECT b.id AS building_id, b.names.primary AS building_name, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS service_count FROM lisbon_buildings b JOIN lisbon_places p ON ST_Intersects(b.geometry, p.geometry) WHERE p.basic_category = 'personal_or_beauty_service' AND b.subtype = 'residential' GROUP BY b.id, b.names.primary ORDER BY service_count DESC, building_id LIMIT 10;

question: open places per building height over 30 m top 10
sql: SELECT b.id AS building_id, b.names.primary AS building_name, b.height, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS place_count FROM lisbon_buildings b JOIN lisbon_places p ON ST_Intersects(b.geometry, p.geometry) WHERE b.height > 30 AND p.operating_status = 'open' GROUP BY b.id, b.names.primary, b.height ORDER BY place_count DESC, building_id LIMIT 10;

question: wellness services in flat-roof buildings by subtype
sql: SELECT b.subtype, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS wellness_count FROM lisbon_buildings b JOIN lisbon_places p ON ST_Intersects(b.geometry, p.geometry) WHERE p.basic_category = 'wellness_service' AND b.roof_shape = 'flat' GROUP BY b.subtype ORDER BY wellness_count DESC, b.subtype;
